summary: Backend-only testing of new POST /api/library/materials/{id}/duplicate and POST /api/cohorts/{id}/duplicate endpoints. Created /app/backend/tests/test_duplicate_endpoints.py with 8 pytest cases covering happy path, file-bytes integrity (GridFS), template behavior (empty cohort_ids/student_ids), source-not-mutated, library re-link on cohort duplicate, inline material cloning with new gridfs_id, no submission copy, ACL 403 for outsider instructor, 404 for missing cohort, 410 for legacy library material with missing disk file, plus regression for /assign, /unassign, PUT /library/materials/{id}. All 8 tests PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4187 lines — should be split into modular routers (cohorts, materials, library, submissions, auth) for maintainability.

duplicate_library_material does not perform any cohort-management ACL check (any instructor or super_admin can duplicate any library material). That matches library-as-shared-templates intent, but worth confirming with PM. The cohort duplicate path correctly enforces is_cohort_manager.

duplicate_cohort silently skips inline materials whose files are missing (legacy disk-only). It returns cohort_materials_copied count, but caller has no signal that some were skipped — consider returning a 'skipped' counter for transparency.
duplicate_cohort uses .to_list(500) — hardcoded limit could silently truncate for very large cohorts. Consider paginating or removing the limit.
Cohort.instructor_id field is set on duplicate but legacy single-instructor field is being phased out — fine for now, but flag for future cleanup.

PUT /library/materials/{id} declares title/description/week_number as plain function params (becomes query params) while also accepting UploadFile — inconsistent with REST conventions but functional; documented behavior so kept as-is.
test_credentials: Super admin slewis@theboostpad.org auto-seeded; sessions inserted directly to user_sessions per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Per-module fixtures create: 1 super-admin session, 1 inside-instructor (TEST_dup_inst_*), 1 outside-instructor (TEST_dup_out_*), 1 student (TEST_dup_stu_*), 1 cohort (TEST_DUP_Cohort_*) with released_weeks=[1,2], 1 library homework material assigned to cohort, 1 inline workbook material. All cleaned up in teardown plus best-effort autouse cleanup of duplicated cohorts/materials and their GridFS bytes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable harness at /app/backend/tests/test_duplicate_endpoints.py. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars exported (taken from .env files). Pytest run takes ~3s. Library-duplicate ACL is permissive (any instructor) — confirm if stricter rule is desired. Frontend Copy buttons on MaterialLibrary.js + InstructorDashboard.js were NOT tested per request.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures after fixing two of my own initial test contract mismatches (unassign uses singular cohort_id; PUT /library/materials uses query params, not form data).
